name: Elinor Vane
appearance: Not yet seen on the page. Known by her hand: quick, slanting, impatient with its own lines. Aldric Vane's sister; at fourteen she told the chaplain at his knighting, to his face, that the sermon was too long.
last_seen_doing: Wrote to Darrow by a road her brother does not know: Aldric does not sleep, and will not tell her what happened at the ford; she asks Darrow to.
now: In Calden with her brother, as far as her letter says, waiting on an answer.
story_so_far: Aldric Vane's sister. Her letter came to Darrow by the miller at the river mill and was opened on the north road: her brother does not sleep, and will not tell her what happened at the ford, and she asks Darrow to.

known_facts.fact: She wrote that Aldric does not sleep and will not tell her what happened at the ford, and asked Darrow to tell her what he will not.
known_facts.evidence: *I am asking you to tell me what he will not, because I think it is the thing that keeps him up.*

known_facts.fact: At fourteen she told the chaplain at Aldric's and Darrow's knighting, to his face, that his sermon was too long.
known_facts.evidence: who at fourteen had told the chaplain at their knighting, to his face, that his sermon was too long.

relationships.label: his sister
relationships.note: She hears him on the stair at all hours, and he will not tell her what happened at the ford.

relationships.label: her brother's sworn brother
relationships.note: She wrote to him by a road her brother does not know, asking what Aldric will not tell her.
